result.summary: The page layout is clean and largely well-structured. The only visual problems found are minor: some secondary gray text may be low-contrast on white. The clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '€2.40 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen', and the '(500+)' rating count) appears to be a light gray on white, which may fall below the recommended 4.5:1 contrast ratio for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color (e.g., to a gray around #6B6B6B or darker) so it meets WCAG AA contrast on white backgrounds.
